name: Side-lying Chest Opening
summary: Lying on one side with knees bent and arms together in front, the top arm opens like the cover of a book while the chest turns to the ceiling.
steps: Lie on one side, knees bent up level with the hips, head supported, arms long in front with palms together.
Breathe in to lift the top arm to the ceiling.
Breathe out to keep opening, letting the head and chest follow the hand.
Breathe in to pause; breathe out to close.

layers.title: Bent elbow
layers.text: Hand slides along the chest for a shorter lever.

layers.title: Arm circle
layers.text: Sweep the arm overhead and round.

cautions.note: Keep the elbow bent and the range small.

cues:
Knees stay stacked — that is what keeps the twist in the upper back.
Eyes follow the moving hand.
Let the breath out soften the ribs open.
